body.value: // We would typically use a custom function here, but we wanted this script to have as few dependencies as possible// Signature:// GetHttpResponseStatusCode ( responseHeaders )// Purpose:// Return the last status code from the response headers// See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_HTTP_status_codes// For example, if the last status line was "HTTP/1.1 200 OK", this function will return 200// Parameters:// responseHeaders// Result:// Response status code// Dependencies:// None// History:// Mislav Kos <mkos@soliantconsulting.com>: Created custom function.Let ( [ 	responseHeaders = $responseHeaders ; 	searchString = "HTTP/1.1 " ; 	searchStringCount = PatternCount ( responseHeaders ; searchString ) ; 	start = Position ( responseHeaders ; searchString ; 1 ; searchStringCount ) ; 	start = start + If ( start > 0 ; Length ( searchString ) ) ; 	end = Position ( responseHeaders ; ¶ ; start ; 1 ) ; 	end = If ( end > 0 ; end ; Length ( responseHeaders ) + 1 ) ; 	numberOfCharacters = end - start ; 	codeWithMessage = Middle ( responseHeaders ; start ; numberOfCharacters ) ; 	code = LeftWords ( codeWithMessage ; 1 ) ; 	~ = ""] ; 	GetAsNumber ( code ))

body.value: // We would typically use a custom function here, but we wanted this script to have as few dependencies as possible// Signature:// GetHttpResponseStatusCode ( responseHeaders )// Purpose:// Return the last status code from the response headers// See https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_HTTP_status_codes// For example, if the last status line was "HTTP/1.1 200 OK", this function will return 200// Parameters:// responseHeaders// Result:// Response status code// Dependencies:// None// History:// Mislav Kos <mkos@soliantconsulting.com>: Created custom function.Let ( [ 	responseHeaders = $responseHeaders ; 	searchString = "HTTP/1.1 " ; 	searchStringCount = PatternCount ( responseHeaders ; searchString ) ; 	start = Position ( responseHeaders ; searchString ; 1 ; searchStringCount ) ; 	start = start + If ( start > 0 ; Length ( searchString ) ) ; 	end = Position ( responseHeaders ; ¶ ; start ; 1 ) ; 	end = If ( end > 0 ; end ; Length ( responseHeaders ) + 1 ) ; 	numberOfCharacters = end - start ; 	codeWithMessage = Middle ( responseHeaders ; start ; numberOfCharacters ) ; 	code = LeftWords ( codeWithMessage ; 1 ) ; 	~ = ""] ; 	GetAsNumber ( code ))
